title: Statistics for any number type
description:
Write `public static class Stats` with generic methods that work for `int`, `double`, `decimal` and every other number type:

- `public static T Sum<T>(IEnumerable<T> values) where T : INumber<T>`
- `public static T Mean<T>(IReadOnlyCollection<T> values) where T : INumber<T>`: throws `InvalidOperationException` for an empty collection;
- `public static T Range<T>(IEnumerable<T> values) where T : INumber<T>`: the largest minus the smallest, `T.Zero` for none.
hints: Start from `T.Zero` and use `+=` inside the loop; `INumber<T>` brings the operator (lesson 8.03).
`T.CreateChecked(values.Count)` turns the count into a `T` so you can divide by it.
lessonTitle: Generic Math and Static Abstract Members
